judgment: The king comes to the temple.
It is good to see the great person.
It goes through. It is good to hold firm.
It is good to have somewhere to go.
image: The marsh rises over the earth: Clustering.
So the noble one keeps his weapons mended,
lines: There is trust, and it does not last:
One cry, one hand-grip — and laughter.
Do not grieve. Going: no harm.
Trust — then it is good to use
Going: no harm. A little shame.
Clustering in high place: no harm.
begin greatly, hold firm long: regret gone.

notes.name_en: 萃 is things/people gathered thick; 'Clustering', not Wilhelm's 'Gathering Together (Massing)'.
notes.L2: 禴 the thin spring/summer offering — 'simple offering', as in 46 L2 (same Chinese, same words).
